name: Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds
description: Compact true-wireless earbuds with 24-hour total battery life, touch controls and a pocketable charging case. Great daily driver for commutes and calls.

name: Mechanical Keyboard TKL
description: Tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches, per-key RGB and a solid aluminium frame. Built for long coding sessions.

name: 27-inch QHD Monitor
description: 27-inch 1440p IPS monitor with 99% sRGB coverage and a height-adjustable stand. A second screen that instantly upgrades any desk.

name: USB-C 7-in-1 Hub
description: One USB-C port becomes HDMI, 3x USB-A, SD card reader and 100W pass-through charging. The dongle that ends dongle hunting.

name: Full HD Webcam with Mic
description: 1080p webcam with dual noise-reducing microphones and a privacy shutter. Look and sound sharp on every video call.

name: Lightweight Running Shoes
description: Breathable mesh running shoes with responsive foam cushioning, sized for daily 5-10km runs. Grippy outsole for wet pavements.

name: Non-Slip Yoga Mat 6mm
description: 6mm cushioned yoga mat with a textured non-slip surface and carry strap. Kind to knees, unfriendly to excuses.

name: Adjustable Dumbbell Pair 5kg
description: Pair of 5kg dumbbells with knurled steel handles and rubber-coated plates that won't scar your floor. Home-gym essential.

name: Resistance Bands Set of 5
description: Five loop bands from light to extra-heavy with a door anchor and carry bag. A full gym that fits in a drawer.

name: Smart Fitness Watch
description: GPS fitness watch tracking heart rate, sleep, SpO2 and 20+ sport modes, with a 10-day battery. Your training log on your wrist.

name: LED Desk Lamp with USB Port
description: Dimmable LED desk lamp with 5 colour temperatures, a swing arm and a USB charging port in the base. Easy on late-night eyes.

name: Ceramic Coffee Mug Set of 4
description: Four 350ml stoneware mugs in muted earth tones, dishwasher and microwave safe. Housewarming-proof gift.

name: Digital Air Fryer 4.5L
description: 4.5-litre digital air fryer with 8 presets and a dishwasher-safe basket. Crispy results with a tablespoon of oil.

name: Robot Vacuum Cleaner
description: Slim robot vacuum with LiDAR room mapping, app scheduling and auto-return charging. It cleans while you don't.

name: Scented Candle Gift Set
description: Three soy-wax candles (lavender, sandalwood, yuzu) in amber glass jars, 25 hours of burn each. The universal 'no idea what to buy' gift.

name: Clean Code — Robert C. Martin
description: The classic handbook on writing readable, maintainable code, with Java examples that translate to any language. Required reading for new developers.

name: Deep Learning — Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville
description: The definitive deep learning textbook: from linear algebra foundations to CNNs, RNNs and beyond. The book behind half the field's vocabulary.

name: The Pragmatic Programmer (20th Anniversary)
description: Hunt and Thomas's timeless career guide: DRY, tracer bullets, and the habits that separate journeymen from masters.

name: Atomic Habits — James Clear
description: The 1%-better-every-day system for building good habits and breaking bad ones. Short chapters, immediate payoff.

name: Designing Data-Intensive Applications — Kleppmann
description: The 'boar book' on databases, distributed systems and stream processing. The single best backend engineering book of the decade.
